references.text: The same principle of building according to the heavenly pattern shown on the mountain. The tabernacle and all its equipment were to be made exactly after the example God showed Moses.
Reiteration of the command to erect the tabernacle according to the pattern shown on the mountain.
The altar of burnt offering was also to be made according to the pattern shown to Moses on the mountain.
The lampstand was made according to the pattern the Lord had shown Moses, fulfilling the command in Exodus 25:40.
David gave Solomon the plan for the temple that he had received by the Spirit, parallel to how Moses received the pattern for the tabernacle.
Stephen refers directly to the fact that Moses was commanded to make the tabernacle according to the pattern he had seen (κατὰ τὸν τύπον ὃν ἑωράκει).

The book of Hebrews quotes Exodus 25:40 directly and explains that the Levitical priests served by a copy and shadow of heavenly things, just as Moses was commanded to make everything according to the pattern shown to him on the mountain.
Shows how the principle of building according to a divine pattern is transferred from the tabernacle (Moses) to the temple (Solomon).
